Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Web Application Engineer to build a modern web-based chat application that connects users with an AI-powered backend built on AWS Bedrock.

This role focuses on designing and developing an intuitive, responsive, and scalable chat interface while integrating seamlessly with AI services through REST APIs. You will collaborate closely with AI engineers to deliver an exceptional conversational user experience powered by enterprise-grade AI technologies.

The ideal candidate combines strong frontend development expertise with backend integration experience and enjoys building user-centric web applications powered by modern AI platforms.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop modern web applications using React and Python.
  • Build intuitive chat-based user interfaces for AI-powered applications.
  • Integrate frontend applications with AWS Bedrock AI services through REST APIs.
  • Develop scalable backend services supporting web applications.
  • Build secure authentication and user session management.
  • Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and usability.
  • Collaborate closely with AI engineers to integrate conversational AI capabilities.
  • Build reusable UI components and maintain clean application architecture.
  • Participate in technical design discussions and code reviews.
  • Ensure high-quality, maintainable, and scalable code.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong React development experience.
  • Strong Python development experience.
  • Experience building modern web applications.
  • Experience consuming REST APIs.
  • Experience working with AWS cloud services.
  • Strong frontend architecture knowledge.
  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Experience working in Agile environments.

Must Have:

  • Strong React development experience.
  • Strong Python development experience.
  • Experience building production web applications.
  • Experience developing chat-based or conversational interfaces.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs.
  • Experience consuming AI or backend services from frontend applications.
  • Experience with AWS managed services.
  • Strong understanding of frontend architecture and component design.
  • Experience managing application state.
  • Responsive web design experience.
  • Experience implementing authentication and session management.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience integrating AWS Bedrock.
  • Experience with conversational AI interfaces.
  • Experience with WebSockets.
  • Experience with Amazon Cognito.
  • Experience building AI-powered web applications.
  • Experience with TypeScript.
  • Experience with modern UI component libraries.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience optimizing frontend performance.

Compensation

Additional Information

Benefits & Perks:

Home office;

Competitive compensation based on experience;

Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company;

International Projects;

Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational);

Games and Competitions;

You can also apply here:

Website: https://www.oowlish.com/work-with-us/

This is a general track role, hiring for every team at Canonical who works in Python, across all levels of seniority. Apply here if you believe you are already an outstanding Python engineer.

Canonical works across the entire open source spectrum. Canonical Ubuntu is well-known as a developer favourite and enterprise-friendly Linux. Our web services and system utilities are often written in Python, which we choose where collaboration with other teams, ecosystems and communities is more important than raw performance.

We hire Python Developers with a passion for open-source software, innovation, and cutting-edge technologies. We also look for colleagues who understand that a great product is more than code – it is ready for the unexpected, it is well documented, it is comprehensively tested, it is tastefully presented in its CLI or GUI. At Canonical, you will have the opportunity to make significant contributions through high-quality, idiomatic Python code.

Your team will own a product that may comprise several codebases. These may be intended to run on servers, or on Kubernetes, or on the desktop, or as web services for Ubuntu clients. They may be utilities or frameworks or tools, or part of our production process.

Additionally, this role will give you the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and ensure seamless software operations at scale.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability 
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills 
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments 
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Experience with container technologies such as LXD, Docker and Kubernetes 
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation 
  • Additional languages, particularly Golang or Rust, C or C++
  • Deep quality and test engineering
  • Web or Flutter front-end experience
  • REST and gRPC API experience
  • SQL and NoSQL data store expertise
  • Experience with public clouds or OpenStack 
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu packaging 
  • Experience with systems programming or scalable web services
  • Performance engineering and security experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Recognition rewards

  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

We are hiring talented Software Engineers with strong Python, Packaging and Linux skills and who want to have a positive impact on the day-to-day workflow of thousands of snap, rock and charm publishers. To be successful on this team you'll need to be interested in packaging formats, build systems and automation that can simplify the lives of developers and engineers trying to ship software to the widest possible audience.

We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps, charms and more recently, rocks.

Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognised names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft.

Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.

And Rockcraft provides the means for container developers to build production-grade Ubuntu-based container images, regardless of their experience as a software developer. These container images are called Rocks and can be found in various popular container registries, like Docker Hub, offering an opinionated and consistent design that focus on security while providing an homogeneous user experience across all rocks.

What we are looking for in you

  • You have expertise in Python.
  • You have a strong understanding of the makeup of a modern GNU/Linux distribution.
  • You have a good understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation.
  • Experience working with container technology, such as Docker, Kubernetes and LXD.
  • Use your familiarity with languages, toolchains, frameworks, integrations, and CI systems to extend the snap build ecosystem
  • Work with external open source and commercial projects to understand how we can better serve community needs.

Job Title: Senior DevOps Engineer

Location: USA (Remote or Regional Office)

Reports To: SVP of Engineering

About Cyware

Cyware delivers an innovative approach to cybersecurity that unifies threat intelligence, automation, threat response, and vulnerability management with data insights gleaned from assets, users, malware, attackers, and vulnerabilities. Cyware’s Cyber Fusion platform integrates SOAR and TIP technology, enabling collaboration across siloed security teams. Cyware is widely deployed by enterprises, government agencies, and MSSPs, and is the leading threat intelligence sharing platform for global ISACs and CERTs.

Why We’re Hiring

Cyware is hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to build, secure, and operate the infrastructure supporting product environments in AWS and AWS GovCloud. This role owns CI/CD, deployment, and operational reliability across commercial and government environments, ensuring releases meet high standards of security, availability, and compliance across cloud boundaries, including FedRAMP High, GovRAMP Moderate, and IL5 environments.

About You

  • You are driven, inquisitive, proactive, and energetic.
  • You have a growth mindset and are committed to delivering results.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • You are passionate about cloud engineering, DevOps, automation, security, reliability, and scalable systems.

Come join an exciting cybersecurity product startup that has closed its Series C funding round!

What You’ll Do

  • Work closely with development teams to integrate projects into production AWS and AWS GovCloud environments and ensure ongoing support.
  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent; support Helm chart packaging and ArgoCD/GitOps deployment into Kubernetes.
  • Operate and harden infrastructure within compliance-heavy authorization boundaries such as FedRAMP High, GovRAMP Moderate, and IL5, maintaining continuous compliance across releases.
  • Own environment segmentation, secrets management, and access controls consistent with NIST 800-53 and FedRAMP control families.
  • Manage Kubernetes workloads, Helm chart versioning, and release promotion across development, staging, commercial, and GovCloud production environments.
  • Build reliable, scalable infrastructure services in AWS and support infrastructure for both cloud and on-premise deployments.
  • Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK for repeatable, auditable provisioning.
  • Support database deployment and schema migration using Postgres, Flyway, or equivalent tooling tied to release cycles.
  • Build monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational automation to meet government-grade availability and incident-response requirements.
  • Partner with Security/GRC to prepare and maintain evidence for FedRAMP/GovRAMP continuous monitoring, POA&Ms, annual assessments, and audit cycles.
  • Participate in incident response and root-cause analysis for GovCloud-hosted environments, with documentation meeting government audit standards.
  • Gain deep application-level knowledge of systems and contribute to their overall design; troubleshoot application, deployment, and operations issues.
  • Build engineering automation and productivity tools to streamline and scale production applications while minimizing manual interaction.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Solution Architecture, and Security/GRC to keep commercial and government environments aligned with the product roadmap without compliance drift.
  • Be a DevOps champion by building security, reliability, scalability, and best practices into the development lifecycle.

Who You Are

  • US Citizenship is a requirement of this position in accordance with 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(2)(C).
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps/Platform/Site Reliability Engineering, with 2+ years operating workloads in AWS GovCloud.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and maintaining infrastructure under FedRAMP High or Moderate, GovRAMP/StateRAMP, or DoD IL5 authorization frameworks.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance; active or eligible for a federal security clearance.
  • Working knowledge of NIST 800-53 controls and how they translate into infrastructure and pipeline design.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Helm, and GitOps (ArgoCD or equivalent).
  • Hands-on experience with AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent cloud services.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline engineering using Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, or equivalent.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools including Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK.
  • Experience with configuration-management/automation tools such as Chef, Puppet, Ansible, Rundeck, or equivalent.
  • Experience with queuing systems such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, or equivalent.
  • Experience with relational database deployment/migration tooling such as Postgres and Flyway, or equivalent.
  • Experience supporting continuous monitoring, POA&M remediation, assessment, and audit cycles.
  • Basic knowledge of networking concepts such as subnets and environment segmentation.
  • Experience with containers and orchestration tools such as Kubernetes.
  • Ability to create infrastructure services for both cloud and on-premise deployments.
  • Exposure to Linux, EC2 security, AWS CLI, S3, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, SSH, Docker, Git, Jenkins, CircleCI, Nagios, JMeter, and BlazeMeter.
  • Experience with startup environments and lean, collaborative engineering teams.
  • Knowledge of MongoDB, Python/Django, data structures, and algorithms is an added advantage.

Preferred

  • Prior experience at a cybersecurity or SaaS vendor maintaining a FedRAMP-authorized environment through initial ATO and ongoing ConMon.
  • AWS certifications such as Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer Professional.
  • Experience with container security scanning and software supply-chain security, including SBOM and image signing, in a government context.
  • Familiarity with SOAR/TIP or broader cybersecurity product environments.

We're a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately. If this all sounds like a good fit for you, why not join us?

Why You’ll Love Working at Cyware

We foster an exciting and challenging start-up culture.

  • We’re not just employees. We’re people. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including time off, paid holidays, retirement plans, insurance coverage and much more.
  • We’ll invest in your career. Our company is growing quickly and we will give you the opportunity to do the same. You will have access to a number of professional development opportunities so that you can keep up with the company’s evolving needs.
  • We offer competitive compensation packages. We deeply value the talent our team brings to the table and believe that fair and equitable total compensation packages are part of our commitment to everyone who works here.

We value diversity of people, culture, and ideas.

How to Apply

Apply right here. You've found the application!

EEO Statement: Cyware is dedicated to hiring a diverse workplace that celebrates an inclusive culture and a sense of belonging. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, gender expression, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, veteran status, genetic information or disability.

Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced, highly technical and customer-centric Forward Deployed Engineer - DevOps/SRE to join our Customer Success team. In this role, you will play a crucial role as a technical solution expert and advisor working closely with some of the largest Harness AppSec customers to design, implement and optimize Harness platform and adoption strategies to ensure they realize maximum value and outcomes.

Our team is small, collaborative, and deeply motivated — we work at the intersection of technology, security, and business, and we bring curiosity and rigor to a wide range of challenges. You will have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a rapidly growing company while helping customers harness the power of our AI-enabled DevSecOps platform to build and deliver software securely and efficiently — including protecting AI applications from emerging threats.

We prioritize psychological safety, mentorship, and continuous learning. Whether you're coming from engineering, architecture, consulting, or security — we want to hear from you.

About the role

listings.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across many sectors.

Canonical is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1,200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager for Distributed Systems Testing to lead a team responsible for the quality engineering platform that enables deployment and validation of distributed systems across Canonical's cloud portfolio.

We see quality engineering as a first-class engineering practice. Our Distributed Systems Testing team ensures the performance, correctness, resilience and interoperability of Canonical cloud solutions built with technologies such as Juju, Terraform, OpenStack and Kubernetes. These systems are deployed and tested across diverse environments, from bare-metal to the public cloud.

As Engineering Manager, you will combine strong software engineering judgement with people leadership. You will develop engineering talent, establish effective engineering practices, shape technical direction with senior engineers, and ensure the team delivers high-quality testing infrastructure and automation that enables engineering teams across Canonical to ship software with confidence.

We believe engineering managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. You should be comfortable reviewing patches, evaluating software design, debugging a distributed system, or discussing test architecture. You will contribute technically where appropriate to set a high standard, while recognizing that your greatest impact comes from shaping the direction, focus, effectiveness, and growth of the whole team.

You will work closely with senior engineers and engineering leaders across Canonical to define priorities, improve testing capabilities, and advance how we validate increasingly complex cloud-native and distributed systems.

Location: This is a globally remote role, typically leading a team concentrated within a major time zone such as EMEA or the Americas.

What you'll do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of software and quality engineers, ranging from graduate to senior level
  • Set clear expectations, strengthen engineering practices, and ensure timely delivery against agreed goals
  • Partner with senior engineers to shape technical strategy, architecture, roadmap, and engineering standards
  • Guide the development of automated testing infrastructure for the reliability, interoperability, and resilience of distributed systems
  • Improve CI pipelines, testing tools, and reporting used to validate Canonical's products and solutions across bare-metal, private and public cloud environments
  • Enable engineering teams across Canonical to adopt effective distributed-systems testing practices and tooling
  • Contribute technical leadership through design and code reviews, debugging, and hands-on engineering where appropriate
  • Represent the team with stakeholders and collaborate across Canonical on quality engineering, infrastructure, and developer experience

What we're looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Experience in leading, coaching, and mentoring software engineers
  • Professional software engineering experience with Python or Go
  • Expertise in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, quality engineering, or a closely related domain
  • Strong knowledge of modern software testing processes, strategies, and automation
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Strong technical judgement and the ability to engage meaningfully in code reviews, architecture discussions, and software design

Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About the Role

Join our Customer Engineering team, where you'll own complex, often ambiguous technical issues for enterprise customers, broken pipelines, deployment failures, connectivity problems, misconfigured infrastructure through to resolution, and feed what you learn back to Product and Engineering.

This role works whether you're early in your career and want to get hands-on with real production systems fast, with mentorship built in or you're an experienced DevOps/SRE/platform engineer who wants direct customer impact without giving up hands-on coding.

What You'll Do

  • Own customer cases end-to-end on your team, triage, root-cause analysis, and resolution across Kubernetes, ECS, Docker, and AWS/GCP/Azure including occasional customer build engagements (~20–30% of time) where you'll shadow and co-build alongside a senior engineer.
  • Contribute to customer-facing tooling and small product fixes alongside Product and Engineering, turning patterns from your casework into reusable diagnostics, dashboards, or bug fixes.
  • Lead or actively participate in customer calls and screen shares, communicating findings clearly to both engineers and managers.
  • Build internal scripts and diagnostic tools that speed up the team's casework, with growing exposure to our AI/LLM-powered internal tooling as that practice matures.
  • Turn recurring patterns into run books, playbooks, and reusable templates for the broader team.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years in a customer-facing engineering, DevOps, SRE, or platform role or equivalent depth from internships, personal projects, or open-source work. Depth and curiosity matter more than years.
  • Hands-on with Kubernetes, ECS, and Docker, plus at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Solid grasp of CI/CD concepts and Linux/networking fundamentals.
  • Scripting ability (Python, Node.js, Bash, or similar) and enough coding experience : coursework, projects, or professionals to read source code and make small, guided changes.
  • Clear written and verbal communication comfortable driving a customer call and writing up findings for both engineers and managers.
  • A fast learner, comfortable getting hands-on in unfamiliar systems.

What You'll Grow Into

This team gives you a runway most CXE II roles don't:

  • Leading customer build engagements independently, as you build a track record beyond shadowing.
  • Contributing more deeply to internal AI/LLM tooling as the practice matures.
  • Exposure to observability tooling, Infrastructure-as-Code, AI agents/MCP, and secrets management.

At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

Job Summary

As a Business Systems Engineer on the GTM Engineering team, you will design, build, and operate the automation and AI systems that power ClickUp's Go-To-Market business — spanning core business products and the integration platforms that connect them. This role is AI-native at its core: you won't just maintain existing workflows, you'll actively advance our GTM systems with intelligent agents, LLM-powered automations, and next-generation integration patterns built on MCP, ClickUp Super Agents, and modern iPaaS tooling.

You'll sit at the intersection of business systems architecture and applied AI — partnering with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, and fellow GTM Systems engineers to eliminate toil, accelerate revenue workflows, and build the automated, AI-augmented infrastructure the company runs on. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone deeply fluent in enterprise business systems, excited about deploying production AI, and committed to genuine ownership of the platforms they build — directly supporting GTMSOE's broader mission of operational excellence across the GTM org.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Native Automation & Agent Development

  • Design and build AI-powered automations and agentic workflows across the GTM tech stack — including Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, and MuleSoft — to eliminate manual effort and accelerate business operations.

  • Develop and deploy ClickUp Super Agents and LLM-based automations to automate tasks such as deal data enrichment, quote generation assistance, order validation, revenue recognition triggers, and exception handling in quote-to-cash workflows.

  • Architect and implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations that allow AI agents to interact with business systems contextually and safely — enabling intelligent, event-driven actions across the GTM platform.

  • Explore and evaluate emerging AI capabilities (RAG, fine-tuning, multi-agent orchestration) and determine which are production-ready for GTM business systems use cases.

  • Build reusable AI templates, automation patterns, and agent blueprints that can be extended across the GTM Engineering team.

Business Systems Integration & Architecture

  • Build and maintain integrations across Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, MuleSoft, DealHub (CPQ), and other GTM platforms — with a strong bias toward clean architecture, low technical debt, and supportable design.

  • Own end-to-end integration patterns for critical business flows such as lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, order-to-fulfillment, and revenue reporting pipelines.

  • Design data flows and transformation logic that keep business data accurate, consistent, and accessible across systems without creating fragile point-to-point dependencies.

  • Apply a build-vs-buy mindset: evaluate whether a given automation need is best solved with native platform capabilities, iPaaS tooling, or custom code — and make the case clearly.

Platform Development & Tooling

  • Build internal tooling, low-code/no-code solutions, and lightweight applications using platforms such as Retool, Replit, or similar to extend business systems capabilities with minimal overhead.

  • Write automation scripts and data transformation logic in Python, JavaScript, or Apex as needed to bridge gaps that platform tooling cannot address natively.

  • Utilize Zapier, Workato, and similar iPaaS platforms to orchestrate cross-system workflows that are maintainable, observable, and well-documented.

  • Own the full lifecycle of what you build: discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing optimization.

Reliability, Observability & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor the health and performance of automations and integrations you own; proactively identify degradation, data inconsistencies, or failure patterns before they impact business operations.

  • Conduct root-cause analysis of integration failures or automation breakdowns and drive durable fixes — not just incident patches.

  • Maintain runbooks and operational documentation so that platform behavior is understandable and recoverable by the broader team.

  • Gather feedback from business stakeholders and iterate on existing automations to improve accuracy, reduce edge cases, and adapt to evolving GTM processes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions.

  • Work closely with GTM Systems Engineering, DevOps, and BSA teammates on architecture decisions, intake prioritization, and delivery execution.

  • Contribute to the GTM Systems Engineering operating model: maintain task hygiene, communicate proactively on large initiatives, and log AI/automation work in the team's AI Excellence registry.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for business systems automation and AI — educating stakeholders on what's possible and setting realistic expectations on scope and delivery.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 3–5+ years in a business systems engineering, systems administration, or integration engineering role.

  • Demonstrated experience building and shipping automations or integrations that delivered measurable business value in production environments.

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and at least one ERP platform (NetSuite strongly preferred).

  • Experience deploying AI or LLM-powered automations in a production business systems context — or a clear, demonstrated trajectory toward it.

  • Experience working in a high-velocity environment where you manage multiple concurrent priorities and adapt quickly to changing business needs.

  • Optional but valued: experience with DealHub (CPQ), ClickUp, quote-to-cash workflows, or revenue operations systems.

Skills & Competencies

Technical

  • Salesforce configuration, automation (Flow, Process Builder), Apex, and data model design — admin or developer-level proficiency required.

  • NetSuite workflows, SuiteScript, SuiteBundler, saved searches, and data model — particularly as it relates to order management, billing, and revenue recognition.

  • Hands-on experience with Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier, or comparable iPaaS platforms — including multi-step flows, error handling, and observability.

  • Practical experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.), prompt engineering, agentic workflow design, and MCP integrations. Experience with ClickUp Super Agents is a strong plus.

  • Proficient with Python, JavaScript, or Apex for automation scripting and data transformation; comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and OAuth-based integrations.

  • Strong understanding of business systems data models and integration patterns (event-driven, batch, real-time).

Operational & Mindset

  • Ownership: You take full responsibility for the systems you build — from reliability and documentation to stakeholder trust and continuous improvement. You don't hand off and walk away.

  • Velocity: You move fast, iterate, and ship. You know when "good enough and deployed" beats "perfect and blocked," and you never sacrifice reliability or data integrity to get there.

  • AI & Automation mindset: You default to asking "how can an agent or LLM handle this?" before reaching for a manual workflow — experimenting confidently and evaluating critically.

  • Collaboration: You bridge the gap between technical architecture and business impact, asking clarifying questions, challenging assumptions respectfully, and earning trust with the stakeholders you support.

  • Growth: You stay current on emerging AI capabilities, evaluate what's production-ready, and continuously raise the bar on what GTM systems can do.

What You'll Work With

  • Salesforce: CRM platform — automations, Flow, Apex, data model, reporting, and CPQ/OTC integrations.

  • NetSuite: ERP platform — SuiteScript, workflows, order management, billing, and revenue recognition flows.

  • ClickUp Super Agents: AI-powered automation and agentic task orchestration within the ClickUp ecosystem.

  • Integration stack: Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier — recipe/flow development, cross-system orchestration, and platform observability.

  • AI & MCP tooling: LLM APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic workflow design, and production AI integration patterns.

  • Low-code tooling: Retool, Replit, or similar for internal applications and workflow extensions.

  • Scripting & APIs: Python, JavaScript, Apex, REST/webhook integrations, and JSON-based data transformation.

Platform Engineering at Polar

Platform engineering at Polar is about building and evolving the systems that power our product – keeping them fast, resilient and simple as we scale. We’re rethinking how billing works for a world of usage-based software, programmable pricing and AI agents – from real-time metering and pricing as code, to more flexible customer identities, giving developers greater control over how they monetize their products.

Polar sits in the critical path of global payments, billing and financial workflows. Reliability and correctness matter deeply, but so does our ability to move quickly.

We’re looking for engineers who enjoy working across infrastructure, backend systems and the application layer – from improving foundational systems and shipping new platform primitives to building the tooling and automation that enable the entire engineering team to move faster.

We don’t believe in building infrastructure for infrastructure’s sake. We value a pragmatic mindset and sensibility in knowing when to introduce new abstractions and when the simplest solution is the right one.

More about Polar and how we work

What you could work on

Depending on your experience and where you can have the greatest impact, this could include:

  • Keep Polar reliable at scale: Designing and evolving systems that remain highly available, performant and resilient as traffic and complexity grow – identifying bottlenecks, improving critical paths and designing for graceful failure.

  • Evolve our infrastructure: Improving our cloud architecture, infrastructure-as-code and environments – introducing complexity only where it earns its place.

  • Make production safe and easy to operate: Improving observability, debugging, deployments and incident response so engineers can ship confidently, understand what’s happening in production and recover quickly when things go wrong.

  • Build leverage for engineering: Creating primitives, abstractions and automation that remove operational toil and help the broader engineering team move faster.

  • Engineer for financial correctness: Translating financial and regulatory requirements into robust technical systems, with auditability, access control and data integrity built in from the outset.

What we look for

We’re particularly interested in senior engineers who combine deep systems thinking with exceptional product judgement. People who enjoy solving complex technical problems, take ownership beyond their immediate area and care about building systems that are both robust and easy to work with.

Some of the qualities and experience we value in this area include:

  • Strong technical foundations: Backend and systems engineering experience, including distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and operating production systems at scale. This means that you have built and operated such systems over time to see and understand the pitfalls of the initial decisions

  • SQL and data modelling depth: Strong experience with relational databases, data modelling, query optimization and designing for data integrity and performance.

  • Pragmatic engineering judgement: The ability to reason through complex technical trade-offs, anticipate failure modes and choose solutions that balance immediate needs with long-term maintainability. You’re comfortable moving across infrastructure, backend and application layers to solve the problems that matter.

  • Product-minded: An understanding of how engineering decisions affect the product, with the judgement to balance speed, simplicity and robustness.

  • End-to-end owner: A willingness to take responsibility for outcomes, from understanding the problem and designing a solution to shipping, operating and improving it.

  • Multiplier: An interest in building abstractions, tooling and automation that make the whole engineering team faster and more effective.

  • Security-minded: Treating security, access control and auditability as fundamental engineering considerations rather than afterthoughts.

Experience with payments, billing or financial infrastructure is a strong plus.

We also love seeing open-source contributions and side projects.

Our stack

  • Frontend: Typescript (React, Effect)

  • Backend: Python (FastAPI, Dramatiq)

  • Infrastructure: Postgres, Clickhouse, AWS.

Product Engineering at Polar

Product engineering at Polar is about shaping and building the finance layer for the next generation of AI products. We’re rethinking how billing works for a world of usage-based software, programmable pricing and AI agents – from real-time metering and pricing as code, to more flexible customer identities, giving developers greater control over how they monetize their products.

We’re interested in engineers who enjoy working across our entire stack, solving complex technical challenges while shaping how developers interact with and experience Polar. We value engineers who think beyond implementation, challenge assumptions and bring the technical depth and product judgement to make sophisticated systems feel simple.

We operate as a small, remote-first team with a strong bias towards shipping. We value engineers who can work independently, collaborate when it matters and maintain a high bar for quality without sacrificing speed.

More about Polar and how we work

What you could work on

Depending on your experience and where you can have the greatest impact, this could include:

  • Own product development end-to-end: Identifying opportunities, shipping and iterating on features across our stack – taking responsibility for both the technical implementation and the product outcome.

  • Build exceptional developer experiences: Bringing a strong eye for design, usability and detail to everything you ship. Turning complex billing and monetization workflows into intuitive interfaces, powerful APIs and thoughtful abstractions that make our merchants’ lives easier.

  • Ship with speed and quality: Delivering improvements continuously, balancing fast iterations with robust engineering, performance and attention to detail.

  • Stay close to our users: Engaging with our merchants, to understand how they use Polar, uncover pain points and translate feedback into meaningful product improvements.

What we look for

We’re particularly interested in senior engineers who combine strong technical foundations with exceptional product judgement and design sensibility. People who care deeply about developer experience, have opinions about what makes great software and know that building the right thing often means knowing what not to build.

Some of the qualities and experience we value in this area include:

  • Strong technical foundations: Experience building, shipping and evolving production software, with deep expertise in at least one part of the stack and the ability to work confidently across frontend and backend systems. You’ve built and maintained products long enough to understand how early technical and product decisions hold up as they evolve and scale.

  • Product judgement & design sensibility: A deep appreciation for how products look, feel and work. An understanding that developer experience is the product, from the clarity of an API to the smallest details of an interface. Strong opinions, loosely held, and the judgement to challenge assumptions, simplify complexity and know what to leave out.

  • Ownership & pragmatic execution: The ability to take problems end-to-end with high ownership and autonomy, navigate ambiguity, make decisions without perfect information and take responsibility for outcomes. A bias towards shipping and knowing when to iterate quickly and when to invest in stronger foundations.

  • Engineering craft: A commitment to the quality of what gets built – from clean APIs and robust backend logic to thoughtful interactions, edge-case handling and performance. High standards for both technical quality and the experience delivered.

  • Curiosity & collaboration: A willingness to wear multiple hats, collaborate openly and contribute to a small team. Curiosity to learn new technologies and use tools, including AI-assisted development, while maintaining intimacy with the code, sound engineering judgement and ownership of what gets shipped.

Experience with payments, billing or developer tools is a strong plus.

We also love seeing open-source contributions and side projects.

Our stack

  • Frontend: Typescript (React, Effect)

  • Backend: Python (FastAPI, Dramatiq)

  • Infrastructure: Postgres, Clickhouse, AWS.

• Define a company-wide QA strategy across short-term stabilization, mid-term automation, and long-term quality engineering maturity.

• Design a scalable test architecture using test pyramid principles, shift-left testing, smoke testing, regression testing, release gates, exploratory testing, and risk-based coverage.

• Integrate tests deeply into CI/CD pipelines so failures are visible, actionable, and tied to release confidence.

• Introduce AI-assisted testing practices where useful, while maintaining clear human judgment and repeatable test evidence.

4) Validate Backend, API, Data, and Workflow Reliability

• Test robust REST APIs, Python/FastAPI services, backend business logic, asynchronous workflows, and data-processing pipelines.

• Validate PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenSearch, Celery, Temporal, containerized services, deployment pipelines, and AWS-hosted environments from a QA perspective.

• Create API and integration test coverage for imports, exports, webhooks, permissions, search, scoring, candidate data, customer-specific configuration, and workflow automation.

• Test with realistic and large-scale datasets to uncover performance, latency, search relevance, data integrity, and resilience issues.

• Establish baseline performance, load, and reliability testing using JMeter, k6, Locust, or similar tools.

5) QA AI, LLM, and Evaluation Workflows

• Validate AI-assisted recruiting workflows for accuracy, consistency, explainability, hallucination risk, bias risk, prompt adherence, rubric alignment, and human-in-the-loop behavior.

• Test AI scoring, candidate summaries, recommendations, interview feedback, resume analysis, and knowledge-retrieval experiences across normal, adversarial, and edge-case inputs.

• Create repeatable evaluation datasets and test harnesses to measure AI quality over time.

• Validate guardrails, fallback behavior, citations, confidence indicators, data boundaries, audit trails, and customer-specific configuration.

• Partner with product and engineering to define what “good” means for AI-generated outputs and how release readiness should be measured.

6) Own Release Readiness and Quality Visibility

• Create clear, structured, reproducible bug reports with screenshots/videos, environment details, severity, expected behavior, actual behavior, impact, and reproduction steps.

• Retest fixed issues, validate root-cause resolution, and prevent regressions.

• Communicate QA status clearly before release: passed, failed, blocked, passed with known issues, or requires founder/product decision.

• Build dashboards and reporting for test coverage, defect trends, regression health, release risk, performance baselines, and customer-impacting quality issues.

• Help developers produce testable, high-quality code by establishing testing standards, review practices, and shared quality expectations.

Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s computer vision AI open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We’re curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

What You’ll Do

We’re hiring Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to be the first technical hands on our new customer’s Roboflow deployments. After our Sales and Solutions Architecture team closes a deal and validates the technical approach, you step in to take it from proof-of-concept to production, the critical 0-to-1 phase where vision meets reality.

You’ll embed directly with new Customers, working alongside their engineering and operations teams to build and deploy their first production computer vision workflows on Roboflow. This is the most difficult, important and rewarding phase of the customer journey. Infrastructure is unfamiliar, data pipelines need to be built, edge devices need to be configured, and models need to perform in real-world conditions, not just in a demo or a lab.

The FDE role is more than just execution, you are also our eyes and ears in the field. You'll see the gap between what a Customer thinks they want, and what they actually need. That insight is invaluable, and you'll feed it directly back to our Product and Engineering teams, shaping the Roboflow platform and solution offerings. The best FDEs don't just deploy solutions; they surface the problems worth solving next.

Once you’ve proven the deployment works in production and the customer’s team is equipped to operate it, you hand off to our Implementation Engineers who scale, optimize, and expand the solution across additional use cases. You’re the tip of the spear, the person who makes the first deployment work, no matter what it takes; the adventurer, the explorer, the builder.

Five years from now, FDE at Roboflow on a resume should mean what a few years at Palantir or a FAANG company means. That's the bar we're hiring against.

Role and Responsibilities

  • 0-to-1 Deployment: Take validated proof-of-concepts from the pre-sales process and build the first production deployment. This includes data pipeline setup, model optimization, edge device configuration, and integration with customer infrastructure.

  • Edge-First Engineering: Deploy and operate computer vision systems on edge hardware in physical environments. Where conditions are unpredictable and connectivity is unreliable. This is hands-on, hardware-heavy work.

  • Embed with Customers: Work on-site or deeply embedded with the customer’s engineering team during the initial deployment phase (typically 4–12 weeks per engagement). Build trust, transfer knowledge, and establish the foundation for long-term success.

  • Production Engineering: Write production-grade code that will live in the customer’s environment. Handle the messy realities of real-world computer vision: lighting variability, camera calibration, model drift, network latency, and edge hardware constraints.

  • Be Our Eyes and Ears in the Field: You'll be closer to the customer's real problems than anyone else at Roboflow. You'll surface the gap between what the customer says they want, what they actually need, and what the machine operators on the floor think. That feedback loop back to Product and Engineering shapes what we build next, and it's one of the most valuable things FDEs bring back to the company.

  • Knowledge Transfer & Handoff: Document your deployment architecture, create runbooks, and train the customer’s team so they can operate the system independently. Provide a clean handoff to Roboflow’s Implementation Engineers for scaling and expansion.

  • De-risk New Deployments: Identify and resolve technical risks early. If a customer’s environment won’t support the planned architecture, you find the alternative before it becomes a project failure.

  • Shape the Deployment Playbook: Codify repeatable deployment patterns, starter templates, and reusable artifacts that make future deployments faster and more reliable.

Thumbtack constantly works to balance supply and demand across thousands of local markets and hundreds of service categories. The Pro Growth pod is responsible for the science behind acquiring and activating the right pros, at the right time, in the right markets, to keep the marketplace healthy and growing. As an Applied Scientist on Pro Growth, you’ll build models and experiments that shape who joins Thumbtack, how they get activated, how we forecast supply needs by market and trade, and how we accelerate time-to-value for new pros. We leverage machine learning, causal inference, and optimization to strategically grow and shape our pro supply base. Our work directly contributes to meeting demand projections, unlocking strategic partnerships, and ultimately enhancing customer experience and platform growth by ensuring a robust and high-quality supply of pros.

You’ll work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers, product managers, and other applied scientists on a portfolio that ranges from incrementality and market forecasting to LLM-powered onboarding agents. You’ll own end-to-end: from problem framing, through experiment design, through deploying models to production, through measuring business impact.

What you’ll do

  • Initiate and drive applied science projects to completion, with a focus on the business impact of those projects on pro acquisition, activation, retention, and supply health.

  • Develop, deploy, and optimize machine learning models for supply-side problems, including: lead scoring and pro acquisition targeting, market-level supply forecasting, pro onboarding and activation, retention and churn prediction, and agentic onboarding workflows.

  • Design and execute well-powered marketplace experiments to measure model and product impact on supply and business metrics.

  • Analyze structured and unstructured data such as marketplace interactions, pro profiles, external supply signals, to identify trends, opportunities, and risks related to supply health.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, product management, business development, and marketing teams to define problems, develop end-to-end solutions, and ensure successful implementation and monitoring of ML systems in production.

  • Maintain the right balance between speed of execution and scientific rigor when designing solutions for a fast-paced marketplace environment.

  • Contribute to evolving the team’s agentic-first ways of working, including LLM-powered tooling, eval coverage, and the use of AI agents in day-to-day applied science.

In order to be successful, you must bring

  • Master’s degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, or related), or equivalent industry experience.

  • 3+ years of industry experience as an applied scientist, data scientist, or ML engineer with ownership of production ML models.

  • Experience in applied science within a marketplace, supply chain, or growth domain.

  • Solid knowledge of machine learning techniques such as classification, regression, embedding-based approaches, and causal inference.

  • Familiarity with modern LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, AWS Bedrock) and experience with agentic AI development practices and tools.

  • Good knowledge of probability, statistics, and econometric methods, including experimental design, causal inference, and optimization.

  • Experience with large-scale distributed systems (Spark, Databricks, or similar).

  • Ability to effectively read, write, and debug code in programming languages such as Python and SQL.

  • Ability to break down complex problems rigorously and understand the tradeoffs necessary to deliver impactful projects.

  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to cross-functional partners of various technical levels.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive seamless execution end-to-end on at least one production ML project.

Search is changing. Enterprise buyers now ask ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews which Customer Experience AI platforms to evaluate, often before they ever visit a vendor’s website. Your job is to make sure Cresta shows up in those answers, shows up accurately, and turns that visibility into pipeline.

You’ll join Cresta’s Growth Marketing team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Growth Marketing and working alongside our Content Marketing Manager on a small team that treats organic search and AI discovery as a core pipeline channel.

You will own day-to-day execution of Cresta’s Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and SEO program. Roughly 70 to 80 percent of your time goes to scaling organic search and AI visibility. The rest goes to growth experiments on new acquisition channels and conversion levers.

This is a high-ownership, hands-on role. You will run the systems that make Cresta’s organic engine work: the AI content workflows, the technical foundation, the measurement, and the testing roadmap. The Content Marketing Manager leads writing; you own how that content gets found, cited, and converted. You will also work with web development, product marketing, demand generation, and revenue operations, and report results straight to marketing leadership.

What you'll do

AEO and organic search

  • Grow Cresta's visibility, citation share, and narrative accuracy across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews through content structure, schema, entity consistency, and third-party mentions.
  • Own our AirOps workflows for content briefs, refreshes, and optimization, and keep improving them so a small team ships more without lowering the bar.
  • Run the content refresh pipeline: spot decaying pages in Google Search Console and Ahrefs, diagnose the cause, and partner with the Content Marketing Manager to brief and ship fixes.
  • Restructure high-impression pages for AI answers: answer-first sections, self-contained answer passages, FAQ and list schema, and clear relationships between products, use cases, and industries.
  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexation, rendering, internal linking, redirects, canonicalization, and site architecture. Work directly in our Webflow CMS to ship fixes, and partner with web development on larger changes.
  • Build an off-site presence program across review platforms, analyst and industry directories, third-party roundups, partner pages, and communities where answer engines source their information.
  • Make sure every product launch and rename gets organic coverage from day one, working with product marketing on URLs, redirects, schema, and answer content.
  • Turn questions from sales calls, support conversations, community threads, and search data into a prioritized answer backlog written in the buyer's own language.

Growth experimentation

  • Design, launch, and read out experiments on emerging acquisition channels, such as community and Reddit, and on landing page and website conversion from organic traffic.
  • Write a hypothesis and success metric before every test launches, then make a clear call to scale it or kill it.

Measurement and reporting

  • Own measurement across non-branded visibility, organic and AI-referred traffic, AI citations and share of voice, and influenced pipeline.
  • Build dashboards that catch ranking drops, indexing issues, crawl anomalies, and technical regressions before they cost us traffic.
  • Connect search and answer engine visibility to pipeline in HubSpot, and keep measured data and modeled estimates clearly separated.
  • Stay ahead of changes in search and AI discovery, and turn them into a clear point of view and a prioritized roadmap.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: You own the content refresh pipeline and AirOps workflows end to end, have shipped your first round of answer-first page rebuilds, and run a recurring AI visibility report that leadership reads.
  • First 6 months: You run the AEO testing roadmap independently, have launched at least two growth experiments outside organic search, and can show which pages and channels are driving pipeline.
  • First 12 months: You are the go-to person for how Cresta shows up in AI answers, and the program you run is a repeatable, measurable growth channel.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you do, please apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. If you are coming from an adjacent team and have been teaching yourself AEO on the side, we want to hear from you.

Minimum requirements

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in SEO, growth marketing, or other organic growth roles, with hands-on ownership of a live website.
  • A track record of growing organic traffic and pipeline or signups, not just rankings.
  • Hands-on experience with AEO or GEO, including how AI assistants retrieve, summarize, and cite content, plus at least one project or test you can walk us through, including self-directed ones.
  • Technical SEO fluency and comfort shipping changes yourself: HTML basics, schema markup, and working inside a CMS.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, Ahrefs or Semrush, and GA4, plus an AI visibility tool such as Ahrefs Brand Radar or Profound.
  • Experience defining metrics, building dashboards, and using data to prioritize work, including reconciling conflicting sources and forming your own conclusion.
  • Clear, precise writing. You can write a brief a writer can execute without a follow-up meeting, and an answer passage an LLM can quote.
  • A high bar for quality and full ownership from idea through implementation and measurement.

Preferred qualifications

  • In-house SEO or growth experience at a B2B SaaS company with an enterprise sales motion or a technically complex product.
  • Experience with AirOps or building content workflows with LLMs like Claude or ChatGPT.
  • Experience with Webflow, HubSpot, or multi-touch attribution.
  • Experience with crawl and log analysis tools, programmatic pages, or scaled content operations.
  • SQL or Python skills for pulling and analyzing data on your own.
  • Experience running conversion rate or community channel experiments, including Reddit.
  • Exposure to customer experience, customer support, or contact center operations.

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
  • In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

Compensation at Cresta:

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

Compensation for this position includes a Base Salary + Equity.

Base Salary Range: $100,000 - $165,000.

Your recruiter can provide further details. In addition, total compensation includes a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

As Cresta’s Growth Engineer, you’ll build the technical surface of how Cresta goes to market. You’ll develop custom AI agents on Cresta’s own platform for marketing use cases, build the interactive experiences and tooling our growth team runs on, and own cresta.com. This position requires strong engineering fundamentals, high agency, and the ability to go deep in an unfamiliar domain quickly. If you are self-driven, AI-native, and eager to own something end to end, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

AI Agent Creation

  • Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents on Cresta’s platform for marketing use cases, working alongside our forward deployed engineering team.
  • Build the agent experiences prospects actually touch — event registration, demo and trial surfaces, and the moments where someone would rather just ask Cresta a question.

  • Integrate agents with the systems behind them — CRM, marketing automation, event tooling — so a conversation produces a real downstream action.
  • Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams: identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through what you learn deploying against a real audience.

Growth Experimentation and Tooling

  • Build the surfaces that don’t exist yet: launch microsites, event experiences, embeddable tools. When a campaign needs something the website can’t carry, you build it.
  • Build interactive assets that show what Cresta does instead of describing it: calculators, benchmarks, assessments, and demo experiences built on our own product.

The Website

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years working in software development, web development, AI/ML engineering, or growth engineering.

listings.job_title: AI Security Engineer, Detection and Response
listings.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

Our mission at Ōura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Ōura Ring and its connected app. We’ve helped over a million people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lives.Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work - both in and out of the office.We are looking for an AI Security Engineer to join our Detection & Response team. You will focus on building AI agents and automations for security incident lifecycle, threat hunting, and detection engineering. Ōura is building an AI-native detection and response program, where agents investigate and resolve routine alerts and people focus on the hard calls. You will be hands-on in our environment, turning that plan into working solutions that protect our systems, data, and the members we serve.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and deploy AI agents and automations that investigate and triage alerts, write and tune detections as code, enrich incidents, and take approved response actions to automate routine security operations.
  • Run AI-driven threat hunting, and turn gaps in visibility into new detection capabilities.
  • Conduct security incident response from detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review, coordinating with engineering, IT, our managed SOC partners, and leadership.
  • Conduct investigations and digital forensics across endpoint, cloud, identity, and SaaS environments.

This is a remote role based in the US with a strong preference for candidates based on the East coast.

We have offices in San Francisco, San Diego and Los Angeles for those who prefer hybrid or office settings. Ōura employees in other major cities (like Boston and New York) occasionally gather informally at local co-working locations.

What you'll bring:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a primary focus on security operations, detection engineering and incident response.
  • Proven experience leading incident investigations and digital forensics.
  • Hands-on experience writing and tuning detections in security detection solutions.
  • Hands-on experience building or integrating end-to-end AI agents and LLM-based solutions for security operations, such as alert triage, investigation, or automated response.
  • Scripting and automation skills in Python, and experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and infrastructure as code.
  • You are organized, prioritize effectively, and stay calm under pressure, handling incidents alongside long-term build work.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills with the ability to synthesize highly technical concepts into clear and concise language

Benefits

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
  • An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
  • 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
  • Paid sick leave and parental leave

Ōura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Region 1 $151,300 - $178,000
Region 2 $138,550 - $163,000
Region 3 $127,500 - 150,000

A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location.

We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI).

ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at ŌURA are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers!

Stay cautious and protect your personal details.

To all recruitment agencies: ŌURA does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, ŌURA employees, or any other organization's location. ŌURA is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION REQUIRES U.S. CITIZENSHIP.

Role Description

We are seeking a talented and experienced Platform Engineer to join our team. Possessing strong proficiency with Kubernetes, the ideal candidate will play a crucial role in the development and maintenance of our platform, demonstrating a strong understanding of system architecture, problem-solving skills, and the ability to guide junior engineers.

As a Platform Engineer within our organization, you will join a team of dedicated unicorns who are focused on advancing freedom and independence globally. Our teams work on various different technical baselines depending on specific engagements. We focus our Products on the Platform layer, but to deliver for our Heroes, we also work IaC automation, security, and implementation.

Responsibilities

You will help us automate and build a runtime Production Environment and serve as a link between the Applications, either custom development, COTS, or OSS, and that environment, advocating best practices and facilitating communication between the application teams and platform teams.

In this position, you will be expected to:

  • Validate Solutions/Implementations: Ensure that solutions and implementations align with the outlined tasks and business requirements. Conduct thorough validations to maintain the integrity and efficiency of the platform.
  • Independently Problem Solve: Demonstrate the ability to identify and solve business problems independently. Develop small components to address specific challenges without relying on explicit architecture diagrams.
  • Understand Medium-Level Tasking: Comprehend how medium-level tasks contribute to the achievement of overall goals. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate various components into a cohesive and functional platform.
  • Estimate Time and Effort: Provide accurate time and effort estimates for medium-sized tasks. Assist in project planning and resource allocation based on estimated timelines.
  • Demonstrate Programming Language Proficiency: Possess familiarity with at least one programming language. Exhibit a basic understanding of when to use a programming language versus a shell for efficient task execution.
  • Own the Bridge Between Application Development and Production: Own the bridge between the Application Development team(s) and the Production Environment.

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

Clearance & Travel Requirements

  • Clearance Requirement: Active Secret clearance highly preferred.
  • Travel Expectations: 10%–25%.

Required Experience and Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer or similar role, with a focus on system architecture and development.
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud-native technologies such as Kubernetes, Google Cloud, and Docker.
  • Familiarity with continuous delivery, distributed architectures, systems, everything-as-code, containerization, and cloud services.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Ansible) and a basic understanding of shell scripting.
  • Proficient with YAML.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Comfort with debugging systems and reading/writing code.
  • Knowledgeable about DevSecOps/DevOps and CI/CD theory.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a clearance.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications

  • Active Secret security clearance or higher.
  • Experienced in working on a team following an Agile framework in a remote environment.
  • Experience with security automation and familiarity with API Security, Container Security, and Cloud Security.
  • Familiar with architecture security design, monitoring, and performance instrumentation in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Possess a DoD 8570 IAT II certification.
  • Experienced in Department of Defense work, specifically working on a production Authority to Operate (ATO’d) system.

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

What We Work On

  • Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi)
  • Continuous Delivery and automation tooling
  • GitOps
  • Containers

  • Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping
